From: Samir Khanna <samir@openlib.dev>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — GitHub integration and OSS use

Hi Camila,

We recently signed up for Redwood's self-serve and I'm evaluating how Redwood could fit into our GitHub-based workflow. I'm particularly interested in how your runtime could integrate with GitHub Actions and whether there's a recommended approach to keep inference within our CI (we're an open-source infra project: https://github.com/openlib/repo).

Could we schedule a short demo next week to walk through integrations and performance for small to medium repos? We're a small team — ~30 engineers — and would like to understand pricing and SLAs for a pilot.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Engineer
OpenLib

--

Hi Samir —

Thanks for reaching out and for signing up! Happy to run a short demo and walk through the GitHub/Actions integration patterns. A couple quick questions so we tailor the session:

- Who would join from your side (engineering vs infra vs security)?
- Is there a particular workflow you want us to demo (e.g., GitHub Actions inference during CI, GitHub Apps, or a pull-request triage flow)?
- Any constraints around network or data residency we should know about?

I have the following windows next week:
- Tue 2026-03-10: 10:00–11:00 PT
- Tue 2026-03-10: 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 2026-03-11: 09:00–10:00 PT

You can also pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/30min

If you want a technical deep dive, I can loop in Alex Martinez (AE) to join the call — he can answer integration and performance questions.

Cheers,

Thanks Camila —

Tue 2026-03-10 10:00 PT works for us.

Attendees: myself (engineering lead), Priya (security), and one of our infra folks — likely a short 30m sync.

A couple technical notes so Alex can prepare if he joins:
- We're interested in running inference as part of GitHub Actions for PR triage (small models, low-latency per-PR).
- Is there an official approach for running Redwood inside Actions (self-hosted runner) vs calling hosted endpoints from Actions? Security-wise we'd prefer to keep tokens scoped and limit external traffic where possible.
- Do you have references for GitHub Apps or webhook integrations?

Link to our repo: https://github.com/openlib/repo

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.

Samir
